issues.description: Duplicate React import statements in step-3/page.tsx causing module build failure. Two import lines exist: an old 'import { useState, useEffect } from react' and a new combined import, causing duplicate identifier errors.
issues.root_cause: The file has a stale first line 'import { useState, useEffect } from react' followed by a second import line 'import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from react'. The source file shown already has this fixed to a single combined import, but the console log shows the build error still exists — the actual file on disk still has the duplicate. The provided source shows it was partially fixed but the original duplicate import is still present in the real file.

issues.root_cause: Likely caused by dynamic content (e.g., 'Good evening, Amelia.' greeting uses time-of-day which differs between server and client render, or date display 'Thursday, April 16' computed differently server vs client).
